name: SSHI_FullBridge_LCFilter
rationale: The previous best design (SSHI_FullBridge_Zener) failed marginally on ripple in S3 and stability in S5. S3's ripple is likely exacerbated by charging spikes from the SSHI inversion and the non-linear clamping of the Zener diode at 3.3V. S5's stability is likely affected by the low excitation frequency. Adding a second-order LC filter (L2 and C1) between the rectifier output and the storage node 'out' will decouple the high-frequency switching spikes from the load, reducing peak-to-peak ripple and smoothing the mean output voltage to improve the 'settled' metric.
